home.$comment: `station` is where you catch the train out; `rideTo` is where the ride home ends. Decimal or DMS both work.

trip.$comment: A change must fit between minTransferMinutes and maxTransferMinutes, and always happens within one station.

ride.$comment: budgetHours is the whole outing including the train. minHours drops rides too short to be worth the fare. maxDays 1 is a there-and-back day; raise it for overnight trips.
ride.$speedComment: speedByGradient is how fast you ride at each gradient, in percent, per surface. Speed depends on gradient in a way one flat speed plus one climbing rate cannot express: it has no descending in it at all. Anchors are interpolated, and held flat past either end. paved is required; unpaved and unknown fall back to it when omitted, and writing a plain list instead of this object means one curve for every surface. Note the shape of the gravel penalty: it is severe on descents, where you are on the brakes, and slight on steep climbs, where you are slow anyway. Replace all of these with your own numbers.

field.$comment: The continuous ride-time-home map. Costs one BRouter request per sample, so it is opt-in: run `npm run plan -- --field`. radiusKm 0 derives it from budgetHours.

gpx.$comment: Exported tracks: maxPointSpacingMetres inserts points so no step exceeds it, which keeps map-matching importers (Komoot, Garmin) happy over long straight roads; 0 disables. profileStepMetres (a sibling of gpx) sets the spacing of the elevation profile shown in the app.

gtfs.$comment: The SNCF feed encodes service type in the stop point id, not in routes.txt. Every `npm run ingest` prints the kinds it found and what this filter did with each; `npm run stations -- <name>` shows what calls at one place, unfiltered.
gtfs.$kindComment: Said as what to leave out, not what to keep: regional trains are branded by region (TER, but also BreizhGo, Nomad, liO, Rémi, ZOU!, Mobigo, Aléop), so naming the ones you want silently loses whichever region you forgot. These patterns leave out long-distance rail, where a bike needs a bag or a reservation, and road replacements. Set keepStopKinds to an exact list to override this entirely.
